title: Moving between other reports still carries no filters
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Use staging (preferred), or the Tiered Pricing QA site too once the release is deployed there; production is not needed.
  • Note the attached Today picture shows this screen before the release; the steps check that it still works the same way.
  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access', 'Customers — View' and 'Customers — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales By Customer.
  2. Pick customer B in the Customer filter.
  3. Click Parts Velocity in the reports menu.
  4. Click Sales By Customer in the reports menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales By Customer opens.

Step 2:

  • The Customer chip names customer B.

Step 3:

  • Parts Velocity opens with its default filters.

Step 4:

  • Sales By Customer opens with Customer: All customers.
  • Customer B is not picked any more.

AUTOMATION: Not available on Build to test Yet - Last checked 11/14/2026
